experiment: A4c: downstream-aware nested panel extension of nodes 6 and 28 (144 -> 232 / 218 boards) at the frozen P14 ranges
written: before the first new flop solve; source commit 9b450b3c01b6662fe109393f72bfcec71e100171

meaning.not: 162 is NOT a production GTO acceptance threshold
purpose: test out of sample whether the downstream-aware allocation (designed on the 144-board influence runs) works on unseen boards
check whether it reaches equal-24 / equal-288-level seat EV and reliable-node hand-regret precision with fewer solves (162 vs 288)
then decide whether the dominant remaining error is the panel or outer-loop self-consistency
meaning.why_not_132: matches only the three seat-EV metrics; BB vs BTN and other hand regrets predicted worse than equal-24; the target is state + hand -> action frequency + action EV
meaning.why_not_221: its binding constraint is SB-vs-BTN regret, whose isolated->pooled reconstruction ratio is 4.07 and pooled excess 0.00019 (smallest of five); predictor reliability too low to justify 59 extra solves
meaning.SB_vs_BTN: always measured and reported; diagnostic only; excluded from the formal allocation constraint; no automatic top-up whatever its result

ranges: frozen P14: outer_m28_6/k14/terminal_node{6,28}.json (ranges hashes in provenance)

sampling.rule: one sequential draw per stratum continuing the v1/v2/v3 scheme (proportional to raw-flop count, without replacement, from the pool minus the 144 boards), seed 20261004, strata in sorted order; node 6 takes the first target6-12 draws, node 28 the first target28-12 (55 boards shared)

solver.postflop: 1000 iterations cap, target 0.300% pot, check every 25
solver.policy: every new board must reach <= 0.300% pot; a board that does not is reported and its handling decided by the user (no silent re-run with other settings)

estimator: stratified mean per class: sum_s P(s) * mean_{b in s} compat_b(h) v_b(h) / sum P / rho, rho = 19600/22100 (identical to aggregate.py; identity: rebuilt V144 must equal table_measured_144 exactly)

fpc.default: SRSWOR FPC in all 12 strata: bootstrap deviations of each stratum mean rescaled by lambda_s = sqrt((1 - n_s/K_s) n_s/(n_s - 1)), K_s = classes in the stratum
fpc.paired_sensitivity: paired strata design/SRS variance ratio 0.98-1.01 (fpc_paired.json, y~iid pseudo-populations: an approximation, not exact FPC); secondary sensitivity: +-2% on the paired strata variance contribution, propagated analytically through the influence shares (no re-solve); the pre-analysis found the allocation unchanged under +-2%; no re-tuning on new results

bootstrap.scheme: nested paired: per stratum old (12 boards of panel_v3_144) and new (n_s - 12) resampled separately with replacement; V144* from old*, Vext* from old* + new*; FPC rescaling per stratum with the n_s of each estimator
bootstrap.solves: g(V144*_r), g(Vext*_r) per replicate (frozen-table preflop, A3 config, 400 iterations), profiles saved

metrics.seat_swap: dEV_p(A -> G) = EV_p(sigma_G; G) - EV_p(A_p (+) sigma_G,-p; G) for p in BTN, SB, BB (CO reported), positive_loss = max(dEV, 0)
metrics.panel_error_estimate: L_N,i = mean_r metric_i(sigma_N*_r into G_N point) for N = 144 and ext, metrics = seat dEV (BTN, SB, BB) and class-regret excess over G_N own residual at BTN first-in, SB vs BTN, BB vs BTN, SB first-in, BB vs SB
metrics.hand_level: at the 5 nodes, for g(V144), g(Vext) and per replicate: 169-class action frequencies, action EVs (path_nodes ev_bb), strategy regret under each game, argmax switch, mixed flag (max action frequency < 0.99 at positive reach), L1 (diagnostic only)
metrics.refinement: D = g(Vext) - g(V144) per main aggregate and per class; sigma144 -> Gext and sigma_ext -> G144 seat swaps, point and bootstrap

out_of_sample_test.primary_comparison: measured L_ext,i / L_144,i (same FPC bootstrap, same replicates) vs predicted ratio_vs_144_calibrated (raw also shown); prediction error = measured - predicted, and relative
out_of_sample_test.equal24_comparison: measured L_ext,i vs predicted equal-24 loss (calibrated_abs / ratio_vs_equal24_raw^beta); equal-24 itself is not measured
out_of_sample_test.SB_vs_BTN: reported with the same columns, diagnostic only

classification_continuity.rule: amendment 3 (E_r = positive_loss_r - own residual gap; stable: E0<=0 and q95<=0 all whole seats and both directions; sensitive: E0>0 and q05>0 for some; else precision-limited), applied to 144 <-> ext
classification_continuity.expected_before_results: EV-sensitive is likely (pre-analysis: panel loss ~15-20x the ~1e-4 residual floor); this label alone does not decide success or failure
what_decides: comparison with the frozen-range / outer-step proxy (SB 0.0034, BB 0.0022, BTN 0.0005 bb/hand; a proxy, not the fixed-point residual)

numerical_validation.structural: exact (self-splice byte identity, all-seat splice = donor, point re-solves reproduce stored exports)
numerical_validation.floating: |dEV - gap difference| and BR-value identity <= 1e-9 bb/hand (15x the measured deterministic floor 6.7e-11 over 1224 records)
numerical_validation.decision: classification unchanged when every E is moved by +-1e-9; otherwise numerically undecidable (inconclusive)

execution.tracking: long runs as harness-tracked background tasks (idle reclaim kills untracked processes)
execution.restart: check uptime, real PIDs (ps, no self-match), JSON integrity, provenance; resume incomplete boards only; completed boards never re-run

not_done: no post-result threshold or allocation change
no automatic self-consistency or outer step
no node 228, 3-way, 20/25/40bb, production export, main merge
